components.name: Load Balancer
components.purpose: Routes requests to stateless API replicas.

components.name: API Server
components.purpose: Validates inputs and handles link creation and redirects.

components.name: URL Service
components.purpose: Owns mapping writes, expiry checks and lookups; may be colocated with the API.

components.name: ID Generator
components.purpose: Optional unique-ID allocation for an encoded-ID strategy; random generation is also valid.

components.name: Cache
components.purpose: Caches popular mappings with TTLs bounded by expiry.

components.name: Database
components.purpose: Durable mappings with unique aliases and conditional writes.

components.name: Analytics Service
components.purpose: Aggregates click events without blocking redirects.

components.name: CDN
components.purpose: Optional cache of immutable redirect responses with an explicit invalidation policy.

alternatives: Random Base62 strings with collision retry
Unique integer allocation followed by Base62 encoding
tradeoffs.guidance: Encoding alone does not create uniqueness or secrecy.
Deletion and edit semantics determine whether long caching is safe.

alternatives: Partitioned key-value store with conditional writes
tradeoffs.guidance: Both can be correct; defend durability and lookup behavior.

dataModel.notes: Enforce uniqueness atomically; check expiry on lookup.
Return the original result for a retried create request.

flows.name: Create and redirect
steps: Client sends create request with an optional idempotency key
URL service allocates a code and conditionally stores the mapping
A redirect checks cache, then durable storage on miss, respecting expiry
API returns the selected redirect status without waiting for click aggregation

flows.name: Analytics extension
steps: API enqueues a click event on a bounded best-effort path
Analytics workers deduplicate events and aggregate counts
